notes.notes:

notes.title: Update #9: Now playable with HTC Vive
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/qQ8aLJN.jpg[/img]

Hi guys :) We are happy to announce our very first build with HTC Vive support :) Hope you will enjoy the fight against the virus inside the mysterious microworld of the human cell.

The game will auto detect plugged VR device and run on it, but if you are the luckiest man in the world and own HTC Vive and Oculus Rift and they are simultaneously plugged in one PC just use launch arguments as:
[list] 
 [*]"InMind.exe -vrmode oculus"
 [*]"InMind.exe -vrmode vive"
 [*]"InMind.exe -vrmode none" (just regular mode without VR)
[/list]

Thank you :)

notes.title: Update #8: Oculus Rift is Shipping - Big day for VR
notes.notes:
[img]https://s3.amazonaws.com/static.oculus.com/website/2016/03/riftshipping2.jpg[/img]

Finally Oculus Rift is shipping! We are happy to enjoy this big day with all VR community. Now free games InCell & InMind are playable with Rift consumer version as well as with DK2. Also InCell & InMind will be available for free via Oculus Store as soon as reviewrs will push the button :) Thank you, our dear players, for being so awesome!

You can access the game via Steam by enabling the “Unknown Sources” setting in the Oculus desktop app.

Download Oculus desktop app (runtime): http://www.oculus.com/setup
Official Oculus blog post is here: https://www.oculus.com/en-us/blog/oculus-rift-is-shipping/

notes.title: Update #6: InCell VR is now completely free
notes.notes:
From now InCell game is completely free for all platforms as well as InMind. This decision was made because we at Nival VR want to make VR projects accessible to everyone. To say “THANK YOU” to our first users (who payed for InCell) we promise to gift our next VR title at no cost (title is not announced yet but is in development since October 2015). It will be automatically added to your Steam library on release day!

Let’s make 2016 an awesome year for VR, thank you guys, you are awesome!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/343740

notes.title: Update #2: Level 3 is not so hard now
notes.notes:
Hi :) New update to meet our player's feedback is here.

[h1]Level 3 was too hard[/h1]

The Level 3 difficulty was designed to be hard. That included the white balls that can fail you if you push them into protein pick-ups and other slowdowns. That said we think that we were a bit overzealous with setting difficulty so high. This update will lower it to a reasonable level.

[h1]NumPad keys is waiting for you[/h1]
If it's more comfortable for you to use NumPad in racing ('8456' as 'wasd' analogue) - now it's possible :)

notes.title: Update #1: TMEAR07 please stop talking
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/396030/extras/intro2.png?t=1441637419[/img]

[h1]This robot-girl makes me crazy[/h1]
To meet our player's feedback the assistant robot has promised to talk much less than before.

[h1]No difficulties but levels[/h1]
Also there was mistake with our difficulty names, so players was unable to find new gameplay features in Hard or Extreme levels (which looked like they were just same thing but a little harder). Now they are called Level 1-3.

We'll make an announcement about community driven features soon :)
